figurative_meaning_en: fool, unintelligent - a term of reproach
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এতটা বলদ যে কোনো কথাই বোঝে না।
এই বলদটার মতো কাজ করিস না!
example_sentences_in_english: He's such a dumb ox that he doesn't understand a word.
note: Derived from the common use of oxen in Bengali agrarian society, symbolizing dullness or stubbornness.
